## 🧹 Maintenance Guidelines

Use this template for non-feature, non-bug work that keeps the project healthy: refactors, dependency upgrades, infrastructure improvements, documentation cleanups and other housekeeping work.

## Description

Describe the maintenance task. What needs to change and where in the codebase?

## Motivation

Why is this maintenance work needed? Examples: outdated dependency, accumulated tech debt, performance, security, developer experience.

## Scope

Outline what is and is not included in this work.

**In scope:**

- ...

**Out of scope:**

- ...

## Risks

What could go wrong? Are there breaking changes, data migrations or rollbacks to consider?

## Verification Plan

How will we confirm the maintenance was successful?

- [ ] Tests pass locally and in CI
- [ ] Linting and formatting pass
- [ ] Manual smoke test of affected areas
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated

## Additional Context

Add links to related issues, dashboards, dependency changelogs or runbooks here.
